headline: Som Distilleries submits AGM voting results and scrutinizer report
hook: AGM scrutiny report and voting results
summary: Som Distilleries & Breweries Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine compliance filing fulfilling regulatory disclosure requirements following the company's annual shareholder meeting. Indian retail investors holding shares in Som Distilleries can review the passed resolutions through exchange filings. The filing has no direct impact on the broader market or stock price.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate stock impact
